tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Backoffice & Data Management Specialist | Taxonomy, Product Content & PIM Integration
tailoring.summary: Techno-functional developer with 5+ years of professional experience supporting enterprise e-commerce platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell. Deep hands-on experience working with SAP Hybris Backoffice, product catalogs, and PIM/MDM integrations to support product content, taxonomy, and data management activities. Proven delivery synchronizing product data across global channels using Hotfolders, DataHub, and Impex. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer and Business User with strong analytical skills, based in Karlsruhe.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Taxonomist
cover_en.hook: 3M's global scale and vast catalog of science-driven products require pristine taxonomy and master data integrity across every customer touchpoint. With over five years of hands-on experience managing product content, catalog structures, and data flows on SAP Commerce Cloud at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am eager to contribute to 3M's taxonomy and data operations.

bullets.label: Hybris Backoffice & Content Management
bullets.text: Customized Backoffice components and authored Impex scripts and Groovy administrative routines at Shell to manage product attributes, catalog structures, and ongoing data maintenance.

bullets.label: PIM & MDM Catalog Synchronization
bullets.text: Designed, built, and optimized PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines using Profisee, Hotfolders, and DataHub at Rockwell Automation, ensuring synchronized product taxonomy and content across international channels.

bullets.label: Data Quality & Classification
bullets.text: Investigated and resolved cross-system integration and data bottlenecks between SAP ERP, MDM, and PIM systems, maintaining rigorous taxonomy accuracy and data consistency.

bullets.label: Search Indexing & Business Analysis
bullets.text: Configured Apache Solr search indexing and FlexibleSearch queries while gathering requirements with business teams and product owners to translate classification rules into functional specifications.

cover_en.logistics: I reside in Karlsruhe, Germany, and hold a valid German residence and work permit requiring no sponsorship. I am currently serving my notice period with my last working day on 15 December 2026, and I am available to start on 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how my experience can support 3M's data and taxonomy goals.

tailoring.why_company: 3M's reputation for applying science to improve lives is built on an expansive portfolio of thousands of innovative products. Managing taxonomy and product content at this scale is mission-critical to customer discovery and operational efficiency. I want to bring my background in SAP Hybris Backoffice, PIM pipelines, and product catalog management to help ensure 3M's catalog data is clean, structured, and seamlessly accessible worldwide.
tailoring.motivation_short: With 5+ years optimizing product content, Backoffice configurations, and PIM data pipelines in SAP Commerce environments, I am excited to apply my taxonomy, catalog management, and data integration expertise to support 3M's diverse global product catalog.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Dear Hiring Team, I saw the Taxonomist opening at 3M. With 5+ years managing product content, Hybris Backoffice, and PIM/MDM data pipelines at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I would love to bring my catalog and taxonomy background to 3M. I welcome the chance to connect!
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Taxonomist position at 3M.

With over five years of professional experience supporting product content, taxonomy structures, Hybris Backoffice, and PIM/MDM integrations at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I offer strong technical and data management expertise for your team. I hold a valid German work permit and am available starting 16 December 2026.

Thank you for your time and consideration.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
